backtest_bias_warning.bias_type: lookahead — non-date-gated spray data in retrospective matrix
backtest_bias_warning.detail: In feature_sprint_d1.py Phase B, spray_sc is loaded as a full-season aggregate for each season (game_date_lt=TODAY for 2025, full season for 2022-2024) and applied uniformly to all game rows without per-row date gating. A game row from April 2025 therefore receives pull_rate_fly computed from all 2025 fly balls through the run date rather than only fly balls prior to that game. Because pull tendency is a highly stable within-season trait (r~0.9+), the inflation is expected to be small but unquantified.
backtest_bias_warning.treatment: These backtest figures are OPTIMISTIC UPPER BOUNDS. Do not use for capital allocation above $10/unit until the rolling spray recompute (see backlog) has been completed and validated.
backtest_bias_warning.production_status: CLEAN — build_daily_features.py fetches spray-{SEASON}.json with game_date_lt=TODAY each day, so live inference only uses spray data through the current date. No lookahead in production.
backtest_bias_warning.remediation_schedule: Rolling spray recompute deferred until after first full week of live data. Live results logger calibration data takes priority.

inference_steps: 1. Compute hr_rate_bayes: (hr_total + ALPHA) / (pa + ALPHA + BETA) where ALPHA=200*GLOBAL_HR, BETA=200*(1-GLOBAL_HR)
2. Compute temp_adj: (temp_f - 70) * 0.003; set 0 for dome venues
3. Compute wind_adj: wind_out_mph * 0.002 (positive=out); set 0 for dome venues
4. Compute pull_park_score: pull_rate_fly × directional_park_factor; leave null (do NOT impute 0) if spray data unavailable
5. Look up pitcher_zone_pct from FanGraphs pitcher blob (zone_pct key)
6. Impute all 11 features with train_medians.json values where null (except pull_park_score which uses its own median)
7. Stack feature vector in strict index order [0..10]

ev_thresholds.note: RR filter also applies: kelly_fraction > 0 (positive EV given the odds)
